Chapter 1100: 25: Fierce Sun Splits The Sky (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1100: Chapter 25: Fierce Sun Splits the Sky (Seeking Subscription)

At the deepest point of the bloodline, a complete divine skill imprint fully formed.

Enshrouded in mist.

Dazzling and intertwined.

Lin Yuan carefully observed and felt.

In a daze, he found himself in a world plunged into endless darkness.

There was not the slightest bit of light here, filled with coldness and lifeless silence.

At this moment.

Somewhere in the world.

A flame suddenly ignited.

The appearance of the flame broke the eternal silence.

For the first time, this world had the concept of light.

Had the concept of heat.

The flame burned, and light and heat spread.

A brand new world was opened up.

Finally, the flame transformed into a Fierce Sun, eternally hanging above the sky.

Wherever the firelight shone, it was all within the dominion.

…

Lin Yuan quietly sat cross-legged, but his heart was unable to remain calm for a long time.

Even if he stopped contemplating that divine skill mark, scenes he had just seen couldn’t help but float in his mind.

Who could have thought that this time the Physical Body Divine Ability he awakened had such distant implications, on the surface it merely looked like a scene of a Fierce Sun emerging in endless darkness.

But in reality, as this Fierce Sun’s light covered and spread, a complete world was opened up.

Opening up a world? For the current Lin Yuan, it wasn’t a difficult task, but the world opened up by the Fierce Sun was so high-level that it might be modeled after this source world where Lin Yuan resides.

Opening the source world? How vast the source world is, more mysterious than the Chaos Void, wanting to open such a world is something nearly impossible to accomplish.

“Thirteen-level time life… truly terrifying.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, marveling inwardly.

The creator of the “Infinite Void”, that thirteen-level time life, wanted to use this foundational legacy to nurture an inner universe comparable to the Chaos Void.

And this time, the Physical Body Divine Ability Lin Yuan awakened, originates from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, a thirteen-level time life, with the ultimate goal of opening up such a vast world as a source world.

“Thirteen-level time life has basically occupied a dimensional space, their perspective is not on the dimension they are in, but desires to explore and occupy more dimensions.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Dimension is a broad concept, the scope it encompasses surpasses the Chaos Void or the source world.

Both the Chaos Void and the source world are parts of a certain dimensional space.

“The current me is too far from a thirteen-level time life.”

Lin Yuan gently shook his head, the twelfth level and the thirteenth level, though seemingly only one level apart, are actually the distinction between a figure in a painting and someone outside of it.

“This Physical Body Divine Ability…”

Lin Yuan continued to observe that divine skill mark, pondering for a moment, “let’s call it ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Sky’.”

In fact, whether it is the first type of Physical Body Divine Ability, or the current seventh type, they have no specific names, it is Lin Yuan who names them based on the effects and functions of the divine skill.

The seventh type of Physical Body Divine Ability, in essence, is a Fierce Sun hanging high, where the firelight shines, is the dominion, that is, the world opened by the Fierce Sun.

So Lin Yuan named it ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Sky.’

“Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted slightly, and a flame coalesced in front of him.

This flame faintly emitted an inexplicable aura, as the surrounding space-time transformed rapidly and assimilated in its reflection.

If Lin Yuan infused energy into this flame continuously at this moment, sustaining its burn and spread, it would theoretically evolve into a second eternal Fierce Sun.

Illuminating the vast Ancient Country.

Of course, it’s just theoretical, firstly, Lin Yuan doesn’t have that much energy to sustain it.

Secondly, even if he did, allowing this flame to evolve would ultimately alarm that real eternal Fierce Sun above the sky.

“Opening the sky?” Lin Yuan examined the slowly burning flame, “With my current realm and strength, opening a world like the source world is impossible, but now with the help of the awakened Physical Body Divine Ability, have I indirectly achieved it?”

Opening up heaven and earth requires using one’s own rules and avenues to replace the rules and avenues of heaven and earth.

Whether it is the rules and avenues of Chaos Void or those of the source world, it’s an endless vastness, just relying on Lin Yuan’s comprehended rules and avenues to open up such heaven and earth would be no different than a fool’s dream.

“This is divine skill…”

Lin Yuan remarked with emotion, not yet mastered, not yet comprehended, but able to be used, able to be displayed.

To put it simply, it’s similar to Lin Yuan at the first level, performing moves that required the comprehension of complete Space Rules to execute.

Of course, such forcibly executed moves are extremely mechanical compared to those truly comprehended Space Rules entities and won’t adapt.

Just the same move over and over.

But without a doubt, it certainly can crush same-level strong opponents.

…

“With my current strength, fully activating this divine skill could likely maintain about three seconds of ‘Fierce Sun’.”

Lin Yuan thought, “But within these three seconds, a Great Lord level expert absolutely can’t withstand it, even one at the peak would die, and perhaps a Heavenly Venerate could survive.”

The divine skill ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Sky’ is evidently equivalent to a thirteen-level secret technique.

However, limited by Lin Yuan’s strength foundation, he is unable to unleash the full power of this secret technique.

Even so, it can allow a dominator level lifeform to kill a peak Great Lord lifeform.

From dominator to Great Lord, it is a difference akin to heaven and earth, even the core royals of various Ancient Countries can at most challenge a Great Lord at a dominator level.

As for killing a Great Lord?

Let alone a peak Great Lord?

Even Lin Yuan, with countless foundations, only dared, after reaching the extreme at the dominator level and refining various methods like the “Infinite Void” to its utmost extent, to feel confident he had the strength to kill a peak Great Lord.
